speaker: commentator
text: Welcome to Delaware, the First State. First state, first peach. Run!

speaker: commentator
text: Pennsylvania, the Keystone State. Keep that stone between you and the peach.

speaker: commentator
text: New Jersey, the Garden State. Fruit grows fast around here.

speaker: commentator
text: Georgia. The Peach State. Oh no. It's got friends here.

speaker: commentator
text: Connecticut, the Constitution State. Article Two says: keep running.

speaker: commentator
text: Massachusetts. The Bay State. No tea parties, there's a peach behind you.

speaker: commentator
text: Maryland, the Old Line State. Hold the line!

speaker: commentator
text: South Carolina, the Palmetto State. Mind the swamp.

speaker: commentator
text: New Hampshire. Live free or get squished.

speaker: commentator
text: Virginia, the Old Dominion. Lots of presidents were born here. Most of them could run.

speaker: commentator
text: New York, the Empire State. The peach has heard of you.

speaker: commentator
text: North Carolina, the Tar Heel State. Sticky heels are not ideal.

speaker: commentator
text: Rhode Island, the Ocean State. Small state. Short sprint. Go!

speaker: commentator
text: Vermont, the Green Mountain State. Maple syrup won't slow it down.

speaker: commentator
text: Kentucky, the Bluegrass State. Run like it's derby day.

speaker: commentator
text: Tennessee, the Volunteer State. Nobody volunteered to be squished.

speaker: commentator
text: Ohio, the Buckeye State. Seven presidents came from Ohio. Be the one that gets out.

speaker: commentator
text: Louisiana, the Pelican State. Peach cobbler is a regional dish. Be warned.

speaker: commentator
text: Indiana, the Hoosier State. Hoosier favourite fruit? Not this one.

speaker: commentator
text: Mississippi, the Magnolia State. Smell the flowers later.

speaker: commentator
text: Illinois, the Land of Lincoln. Abe would want you to keep going.

speaker: commentator
text: Alabama, the Yellowhammer State. Hammer that pace.

speaker: commentator
text: Maine, the Pine Tree State. Lots of trees. One peach.

speaker: commentator
text: Missouri, the Show-Me State. Show me some speed!

speaker: commentator
text: Arkansas, the Natural State. Running from fruit is perfectly natural.

speaker: commentator
text: Michigan, the Great Lakes State. Do not stop for a swim.

speaker: commentator
text: Florida, the Sunshine State. The peach is ripening in this heat.

speaker: commentator
text: Texas, the Lone Star State. Everything's bigger here. Including the peach.

speaker: commentator
text: Iowa, the Hawkeye State. First caucus, first squish? Not today.

speaker: commentator
text: Wisconsin, the Badger State. That peach won't stop badgering you.

speaker: commentator
text: California, the Golden State. Halfway, ish. Keep it golden.

speaker: commentator
text: Minnesota, the North Star State. Follow the star. Away from the peach.

speaker: commentator
text: Oregon, the Beaver State. Busy busy busy.

speaker: commentator
text: Kansas, the Sunflower State. Flat, fast and fruity.

speaker: commentator
text: West Virginia, the Mountain State. Uphill both ways.

speaker: commentator
text: Nevada, the Silver State. Want to bet on the peach? Neither do we.

speaker: commentator
text: Nebraska, the Cornhusker State. Shuck and run.

speaker: commentator
text: Colorado, the Centennial State. Thin air, thick peach.

speaker: commentator
text: North Dakota, the Peace Garden State. No peace for you.

speaker: commentator
text: South Dakota. Mount Rushmore. Some familiar faces up there, cheering you on.

speaker: commentator
text: Montana, the Treasure State. Your treasure is not being squished.

speaker: commentator
text: Washington State, the Evergreen State. Wrong Washington. Keep going.

speaker: commentator
text: Idaho, the Gem State. You're a gem. Run like one.

speaker: commentator
text: Wyoming, the Equality State. The peach treats everyone equally. Badly.

speaker: commentator
text: Utah, the Beehive State. Be busy. Be quick.

speaker: commentator
text: Oklahoma, the Sooner State. Sooner you run, the better.

speaker: commentator
text: New Mexico, the Land of Enchantment. The peach is not enchanted.

speaker: commentator
text: Arizona, the Grand Canyon State. Do not fall in. Do not stop.

speaker: commentator
text: Alaska, the Last Frontier. How did a peach get up here?

speaker: commentator
text: Hawaii. Aloha! Also, goodbye, if you slow down.

speaker: commentator
text: Washington D C. The finish line. Everybody's watching. Run!

speaker: commentator
text: Ladies and gentlemen, the race for the capital begins!

speaker: commentator
text: And they're off! Fifty states. One peach. No recounts.

speaker: commentator
text: Uh oh. The peach is awake.

speaker: commentator
text: The peach has entered the chat.

speaker: commentator
text: It's right behind you!

speaker: commentator
text: Fuzz detected! Move it!

speaker: commentator
text: The peach is gaining in the polls!

speaker: commentator
text: Squished! That's going on the record.

speaker: commentator
text: Impeached! Well, partially.

speaker: commentator
text: Fake news! That's going to cost you.

speaker: commentator
text: Don't touch the fake news!

speaker: commentator
text: A flip-flop! The voters noticed.

speaker: commentator
text: Flip-flopping slows you down.

speaker: commentator
text: New chapter. New life. Same peach.

speaker: commentator
text: Halfway through the term. Here's an extra life.

speaker: commentator
text: Impeached! Back to the last checkpoint.

speaker: commentator
text: The peach wins this round.

speaker: commentator
text: You made it to Washington! The peach is furious!

speaker: commentator
text: Victory! Four more years of running!

speaker: georgie
text: I cannot tell a lie. That hurt.

speaker: georgie
text: Onward, to the next state!

speaker: georgie
text: A fine colonial snack.

speaker: georgie
text: Another state, united.

speaker: abe
text: Four score and ouch.

speaker: abe
text: A house divided cannot stand. A peach divided, even less.

speaker: abe
text: Splendid sausage.

speaker: abe
text: Malice toward none. Speed toward the finish.

speaker: teddy
text: Bully! I meant to do that!

speaker: teddy
text: Speak softly and run very fast!

speaker: teddy
text: Rough Riders love a hot dog!

speaker: teddy
text: Charge on!

speaker: teddy
text: CHARGE!

speaker: teddy
text: Rough Riders, forward!

speaker: donny
text: Nobody stumbles better than me. Believe me.

speaker: donny
text: Tremendous running. The best running.

speaker: donny
text: Great hot dog. Very great.

speaker: donny
text: We're winning so much.

speaker: bill
text: I did not trip on that obstacle.

speaker: bill
text: Don't stop thinking about tomorrow!

speaker: bill
text: Mm. That's a good hot dog.

speaker: bill
text: I feel your pace.

speaker: bill
text: Hit it, saxophone!

speaker: bill
text: Smooth jazz, peach.

speaker: dick
text: I am not a klutz!

speaker: dick
text: Let me make one thing perfectly clear: I'm ahead.

speaker: dick
text: Eighteen and a half minutes of hot dog.

speaker: dick
text: Nothing to see here.

speaker: dick
text: Erase that tape!

speaker: dick
text: What peach? There's no record of any peach.
